mapper.select: SELECT employee_id, employee_name, department_id, employee_email, employee_password, hire_date, employee_status_id, employee_type FROM tb_mst_employee ORDER BY employee_id
SELECT employee_id, employee_name, department_id, employee_email, employee_password, hire_date, employee_status_id, employee_type FROM tb_mst_employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT employee_id, employee_name, department_id, employee_email, employee_password, hire_date, employee_status_id, employee_type FROM tb_mst_employee WHERE employee_id ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR employee_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY employee_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_mst_employee ( employee_id, employee_name, department_id, employee_email, employee_password, hire_date, employee_status_id, employee_type ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{employeeName}, #{departmentId}, #{employeeEmail}, #{employeePassword}, #{hireDate}, #{employeeStatusId}, #{employeeType} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE tb_mst_employee SET employee_name = #{employeeName},
department_id = #{departmentId},
employee_email = #{employeeEmail},
hire_date = #{hireDate},
employee_status_id = #{employeeStatusId},
employee_type = #{employeeType}
WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
UPDATE tb_mst_employee SET employee_password = #{encodedPassword} WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
